project.name: Stride - Premium Shoe Brand
project.summary: A modern frontend e-commerce website for a premium shoe brand featuring interactive product browsing, filtering, and cart functionality using mock data with localStorage persistence
project.purpose: Showcase and sell footwear products through an engaging, conversion-focused shopping experience
project.primaryGoal: Drive product purchases through seamless browsing, selection, and checkout flow

assumptions: Using mock data for products (no backend API required)
Cart functionality is client-side only using React state and localStorage
No real payment processing - checkout form collects information but doesn't process payments
Product images will use placeholder images from Unsplash or similar service
Shoes will be categorized by type (sneakers, boots, athletic, casual)
Tailwind CSS for styling with a clean, premium aesthetic

designSystem.artDirection: Quiet luxury aesthetic with generous white space, premium typography, and high-quality product photography. Focus on craftsmanship and material quality through subtle textures and refined details.

colorDirection.background: Clean white (#ffffff) with light gray sections (#f8fafc)
colorDirection.accent: Muted gold (#d4af37) for highlights and CTAs

designSystem.typographyDirection: Clean sans-serif (Inter or similar) with bold headings and elegant body text. Large headline typography for hero sections, comfortable line heights for product descriptions.
designSystem.layoutComposition: Asymmetrical grid with generous margins, clear visual hierarchy from hero to product cards, consistent rhythm between sections with alternating white and light gray backgrounds.
designSystem.surfaceTreatment: Subtle shadows on product cards, thin borders for form inputs, soft hover states with elevation, minimal gradient usage for premium feel.
motionAndInteraction: Subtle hover elevation on product cards
componentStyling: Clean buttons with medium border radius
Minimal input fields with bottom border focus
Sticky header with transparent to solid transition
designSystem.imagery: High-quality lifestyle and product photography with consistent lighting, clean white backgrounds for product shots, 16:9 aspect ratio for hero images, 1:1 for product thumbnails.

content.tone: Sophisticated yet approachable, emphasizing quality, comfort, and style

acceptanceCriteria: Product cards display image, name, price, and rating correctly
Search filters products in real-time as user types
Category filter shows only products from selected category
Product detail page shows all variants and allows size/color selection
Cart persists items in localStorage across page refreshes
Quantity controls update cart totals immediately
Checkout form validates all required fields before submission
Site is fully responsive on mobile, tablet, and desktop
All interactive elements have proper focus states for accessibility
